## Description

New module src/Modules/Conversations: Conversation (channel, status, assignee, taken over by a person or not), Message (direction, sender kind, provider message id, delivery status, body encrypted at rest), Participant, ChannelAccount (tenant, channel, provider ids, Key Vault secret references), TenantAiSettings. A channel adapter interface (receive, send, delivery status). A tenant resolver that accepts only a verified channel identity or a signed-in session. Endpoints for the clinic inbox: list, read, assign, take over, hand back, close. Synthetic tenants CarePlus and ValuePlus in the seed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Every table carries tenant_id under the EF query filter and row-level security; a CarePlus user can neither read nor change a ValuePlus conversation (integration tests on real PostgreSQL, mutation-checked).
- [ ] **AC2.** Tenant resolution never uses message content or a client header; an unknown channel identity is refused and audited.
- [ ] **AC3.** Taking over stops AI replies on that thread until it is handed back.
- [ ] **AC4.** No message text appears in logs, URLs or telemetry; ERD regenerated.
- [ ] **AC5.** Every endpoint declares a policy (architecture test).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
